derivation.shadow: Count terminal provider attempts from the checksum-bound shadow run. Every attempt must be trace-matched, attribution-complete, and emitted with context_rollout.mode=shadow without applying the candidate request.
derivation.baseline_and_enforce: Count terminal provider attempts, failed attempts, and unique sessions from the v12 preflight report after it revalidates every selected raw provider call and trajectory. A failed attempt followed by the same logical call_id and step_id is classified as a framework retry, never as benchmark failure.
derivation.quality: quality_regression is false because the stratified paired Reward 95% confidence lower bound is 0.0; the report does not claim a strictly positive Reward effect.
derivation.security: No typed security violation is present in the selected runtime receipts; absence is recorded as zero and is not inferred from Reward.
